rows.nativeHost: mocked Tauri IPC; no CPAL device
mocked Tauri IPC; no CPAL device

limits: CH tabs inspect sampled SPC state and audition detached snapshots while paused. Copy to Auto is required for editing; no direct edits of the SPC driver or note injection.
Import extracts available initial voices, not every future driver instrument. Existing Echo / PMON and BRR tuning / envelope limitations apply.
Mixer is session-only. Original SPCs and extracted presets are stored in Files / Cassette ZIP; playback position is session-only.
All physical output muted; no human listening or physical CPAL device verification.
No Tauri adapter change, SDK/WASM rebuild, commit, push, tag, release or dist import. No new Looper or Event Rec features.
